desc:
The POM Inert Unit is the safe and realistic way to practice using your POM pepper spray. Filled with a water-based, inert formula (no OC) , it’s designed for hands-on training and skill development — without any active ingredients.

Built with the same flip-top safety design, size, and spray pattern as a live POM unit, it lets you train exactly how you’ll carry and deploy in real situations. Use it to build confidence, test draw positions, and perfect your technique before carrying live OC spray.

Key Features:

Identical design and actuator mechanics as live POM units

Filled with inert, distilled water-based formula (no OC)

Safe for indoor and scenario training environments

Stream-pattern delivery for realistic spray dynamics

Manufactured in ISO-certified facility with traceable batch numbers

Color-coded for easy identification from live OC units

Train with confidence. Carry with certainty.
